selection: source-only; Clean F1 within 1pp of max; maximize five-noise mean F1 then Clean F1 then lowest noise mean CE then earliest epoch
fidelity_notes: Jung: one-cycle 200-point window, THD over harmonics 2/3/4, THD+N=3%, blocked-phase limiter only for OLS/OP classes; each batch pairs clean and augmented views. Hang: scalar healthy-modulus normalization per record, dual VSD planes (fundamental + third harmonic) as the five-phase analogue of the three-phase Clarke plane, 40x40 raster, WCNN-5 with two Haar-LL pools, 15/20 dB paired augmentation. Neither is author-released code; the 3L-NPC switch topology and fault-transient dataset of Jung, and the three-phase Clarke plane of Hang, are not reproducible from the available data.
